visualVariationPolicy: Different meals, serving vessels, spatial compositions, character identities and purpose. Never recolor one table or character to fill fifty slots.

turkeyFocus.rule: New turkey compositions must differ in purpose, serving format, character identity, spatial layout and food grouping; never count recolors or new companions around the same reused bird base as independent artwork.

actualCollectionReview.result: 50 independent source compositions actually viewed: different shared meals, turkey-centered tables and serving actions, illustrated food spreads, three readable greeting designs and four separate outline scenes. Character scenes vary faces, clothing and social setting. Previously inspected standalone turkey platter, pan, slices and drumstick concepts excluded. Existing references are not copied; repairs and exports never add originals.
